context.person: A person using a social event application
context.user_goal: Keep the event private or proceed after understanding the disclosed visibility.

product_state.preceding_state: An organizer is about to change a private event to visible by link.
product_state.current_state: Anyone with the link can view the event name, date, location, and guest list. Only invited guests can post.
known_facts: Anyone with the link can view the event name, date, location, and guest list.
Existing guests are not notified about the visibility change.
The organizer can switch back to private later, but shared links may already exist.
forbidden_claims: The event becomes searchable by everyone.
Returning to private recalls previously shared information.

challenge: Rewrite the decision or recovery dialog so the person can understand event invite visibility choice, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.primary_action: Change the event to visible by link.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: Sharing the link exposes event details and the guest list beyond invited people.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Keep the event private or proceed after understanding the disclosed visibility.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
